verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents automated identity lifecycle termination (docs-20), HRIS-driven onboarding/offboarding (docs-11, docs-24), and instant access revocation via conditional access (docs-7/17), which together support single-action deprovisioning. However, there is no explicit documentation of SCIM-based provisioning/deprovisioning pushing deactivation to connected third-party apps, nor confirmation that all active app sessions are immediately killed across every SSO-connected service. Missing for 10: explicit SCIM protocol documentation, per-app session-kill confirmation, and independent/hands-on verification of instant cross-app deprovisioning.
